case_name: Snandy vs Nabaneeta Nabanita Bose (nee Sarkar)
facts_of_case: Matrimonial Suit stayed pending disposal of an application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: When a party files an application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, the Court must adjudicate upon it forthwith.
legal_principles.held: From the very language it appears that the purpose of Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act to grant necessary relief for payment of litigation costs is to provide the benefit to the concerned party who is filing the application to contest the matter properly by allowing such litigation costs.

legal_principles.principle: The Court cannot refuse to stay the main proceeding due to reason that if such stay is not granted, the party would be deprived of from contesting the matter by defending the case on its merit only for the lack of monetary capacity to contest the case.
legal_principles.held: The right to defend the case having been recognized in terms of Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act and thereby relief having been provided in the nature of monetary relief by way of grant of litigation costs

outcome.final_order: The Matrimonial Suit is stayed pending disposal of an application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
